/--
Converts a pure iterator (`Iter β`) into a monadic iterator (`IterM Id β`) in the
identity monad `Id`.
-/
@[expose]
def Iter.toIterM {α : Type w} {β : Type w} (it : Iter (α := α) β) : IterM (α := α) Id β :=
  ⟨it.internalState⟩
